entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can attack with your armor spikes while using bull rush or overrun.

Prerequisite(s): Proficient in spiked armor.

Benefit(s): When you succeed at a bull rush or overrun combat maneuver, you may automatically make an attack roll with your armor spikes against the target of the maneuver as a swift action, using your highest attack bonus.

Combat Trick

Note If using the optional Stamina Pool rules, the following trick may be used with this feat.

Combat Trick: You can spend 4 stamina points after succeeding at a bull rush or overrun combat maneuver check to use Spiked Destroyer against that target as a free action.
